name: inline-image-hero
title: Inline image hero
description: An agency statement set at display size with small rounded pictures between the words, so the sentence and the work read together.
docs: parts is the sentence as data: strings and { image, alt?, ratio? } in the order they are read. Words are joined with a space and each picture is set as a pill between them, as high as the line itself and sized in em, so it wraps with the line and shrinks with the type on a phone. The heading reads as one plain sentence: a picture is hidden from assistive technology unless you pass an alt, which is then read at its place in the sentence. kicker sits above the sentence; meta is a list of small facts and cta the one button, both along a rule under it. titleAs makes the heading an h1 when the hero opens the page.
